title: A Study to Learn About the Study Medicine Called Berobenatide, When Dosed Monthly, in Adults with Knee Pain and Overweight or Obesity (VESPER-OA 1)
official: C6491022 - A PHASE 3, RANDOMIZED, DOUBLE-BLIND, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED STUDY TO ASSESS THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF ONCE-MONTHLY BEROBENATIDE IN ADULTS WITH KNEE OSTEOARTHRITIS AND OVERWEIGHT OR OBESITY (VESPER-OA 1)
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the superiority for each dose of berobenatide QM (mg) versus placebo on knee OA pain.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Aged ≥18 years
2. Have BMI ≥27 kg/m2 at Screening
3. Pain in target knee for >12 weeks prior to screening (Visit 1) and presence of pain in target knee for >15 days within the past 4 weeks
4. Currently meeting the American College of Rheumatology (ACR) criteria for Knee Osteoarthritis.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of any form of diabetes.
2. Have a self-reported body weight change ([increase or decrease] greater than 5%) within 90 days prior to screening
3. History of acute or chronic pancreatitis.
4. Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN-2).
5. Patients with any joint disease in the index knee other than osteoarthritis.
6. Prior joint replacement in the index knee.
7. History of joint injections in the index knee within 90 days or other joint procedures within the past 6 months.
